BoundedClauseDeletionSAT:
∀ (G B : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (hB : B ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hbase : ∀ base : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ∈ G → ∀ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 1 units →
      (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (base ++ units) ∈ B ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ units))) (k : ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ (φ kept : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧ List.Sublist kept φ ∧
      φ.length ≤ kept.length + k ∧ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF kept ∈ G ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactHornSAT:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactPackedProductBudgetSAT:
∀ (G B : Language Bool) (hG : G ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (hB : B ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P)
    (hbase : ∀ base : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ∈ G → ∀ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 1 units →
      (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (base ++ units) ∈ B ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ units)))
    (q : Polynomial ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ (base extra : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
      List.replicate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base).length true ++ false :: (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ++ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF extra) = x ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ∈ G ∧ (extra.map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval x.length ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ extra)} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactPackedRenamableHornProductSAT:
∀ (q : Polynomial ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ (base extra : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
      List.replicate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base).length true ++ false :: (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ++ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF extra) = x ∧
      (∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ base,
        ((c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1) ∧
      (extra.map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval x.length ∧ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ extra)} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactRenamableHornDeletionSAT:
∀ (k : ℕ), {x : List Bool | ∃ (φ kept : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧ List.Sublist kept φ ∧
      φ.length ≤ kept.length + k ∧
      (∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ kept,
        ((c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1) ∧
      PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
ExactRenamableHornGuard:

        ((c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P

{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      (∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ φ,

HornClosureCompleteness:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF)
    (hHorn : ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1)
    (hSat : PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ), ∃ s : Finset ℕ, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ s)) φ = true ∧
      (∀ i ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ φ, ∃ l ∈ c, l.1 = i) ∧
      ∀ σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true → ∀ i ∈ s, σ i = true
IndexedWitnessProjection:
∀ (R : Set (List Bool × List Bool))
    (hR : PEqualNP.Library.DecidableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair R)
    (clock : List Bool → List Bool)
    (hc : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) clock)
    (generate : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool)
    (hg : PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) generate), {x : List Bool | ∃ i < (clock x).length, (x, generate (List.replicate i true, x)) ∈ R} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MeasuredCNFRenaming:
∃ applyFlip : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) applyFlip ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (vs : List ℕ),
        applyFlip (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])) =
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.map (fun c => c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (decide (l.1 ∈ vs))))))
MeasuredCappedClauseProduct:
∃ product : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) product ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (cap : List Bool),
        (product (cap,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length = min cap.length ((φ.map List.length).prod)
MeasuredClauseExtraction:
∃ pull : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair PEqualNP.Library.encodePair pull ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (index : List Bool),
        pull (index,PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) =
          (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ.eraseIdx index.length),PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (Option.toList (getElem? φ index.length)))
MeasuredClauseLiteralCount:
∃ count : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) count ∧
      ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, count (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = List.replicate c.length true
MeasuredFirstClause:
∃ split : List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) PEqualNP.Library.encodePair split ∧
      split [] = ([],[]) ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (tail : List Bool),
        split (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c ++ tail) = (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c, tail)
MeasuredHornGuard:
{x : List Bool | ∃ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ = x ∧
      ∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1} ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P
MeasuredHornPairEncoding:
∃ make : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) make ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, ∃ F : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 F ∧ make (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF F ∧
        ∀ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval flip F = true ↔
          ∀ c ∈ φ, ((c.map (fun l => (l.1, xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1
MeasuredHornSAT:
∃ D : Language Bool, D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧ ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
      (∀ c ∈ φ, (c.filter fun l => l.2).length ≤ 1) →
      (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ)
MeasuredHornSweep:
∃ sweep : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) sweep ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (vs : List ℕ), ∃ ys : List ℕ,
        sweep (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ,vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])) =
          ys.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
        (ys.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])).length ≤
          (vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])).length +
            (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length
MeasuredLiteralChoice:
∃ pick : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) pick ∧
      ∀ (c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause) (index : List Bool),
        pick (index, PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause (Option.toList (getElem? c index.length))
MeasuredMixedRadixUnits:
∃ choose : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair (fun x : List Bool => x) choose ∧
      (∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (ix : List Bool), ∃ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 1 units ∧
        choose (ix, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF units ∧
        ∀ σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ units = true → PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true) ∧
      ∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF) (σ : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment), PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ φ = true →
        ∃ i < (φ.map List.length).prod, ∃ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
          choose (List.replicate i true, PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF units ∧ PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval σ units = true
MeasuredPositiveLiteral:
∃ first : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) first ∧
      ∀ c : PEqualNP.Search.Clause, first (PEqualNP.Search.encodeClause c) =
        ((c.filter fun l => l.2).head?).elim []
          (fun l => (l.1.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true])
MeasuredUnaryDivMod:
∃ divide : List Bool × List Bool → List Bool × List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime PEqualNP.Library.encodePair PEqualNP.Library.encodePair divide ∧
      ∀ a b : List Bool,
        divide (a,b) = (List.replicate (a.length / b.length) true,
          List.replicate (a.length % b.length) true)
PackedProductBudgetSAT:
∀ (B : Language Bool) (hB : B ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P) (q : Polynomial ℕ), ∃ D : Language Bool, D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P ∧ ∀ (base extra : PEqualNP.Search.CNF),
      (∀ units : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 1 units → (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (base ++ units) ∈ B ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ units))) →
      let raw := List.replicate (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base).length true ++ false :: (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF base ++ PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF extra)
      (extra.map List.length).prod ≤ q.eval raw.length →
        (raw ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (base ++ extra))
RenamableHornPairConstraints:
∀ (φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF), ∃ F : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, PEqualNP.Search.IsKCNF 2 F ∧ ∀ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment,
      PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval flip F = true ↔
        ∀ c ∈ φ, ((c.map (fun l => (l.1, xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1
RenamableHornSATSearch:
∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF,
        (∃ flip : PEqualNP.Search.Assignment, ∀ c ∈ φ,
          ((c.map (fun l => (l.1,xor l.2 (flip l.1)))).filter (fun l => l.2)).length ≤ 1) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
SparseVariableSATSearch:
∀ (D : Language Bool) (hD : D ∈ PEqualNP.Library.P), ∃ search : List Bool → List Bool,
      PEqualNP.Library.ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) search ∧
      ∀ φ : PEqualNP.Search.CNF, (∀ ls : List PEqualNP.Search.Literal,
          PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF (φ ++ ls.map (fun l => [l])) ∈ D ↔ PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable (φ ++ ls.map (fun l => [l]))) →
        PEqualNP.Search.Satisfiable φ → ∃ vs : List ℕ,
          search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ) = vs.flatMap (fun i => (i.bits.flatMap fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false,true]) ∧
          (search (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ)).length ≤ (PEqualNP.Search.encodeCNF φ).length ∧
          PEqualNP.Search.CNF.eval (fun i => decide (i ∈ vs)) φ = true
